title: BTW Asset Manifest
description: Common schema every normalized manifest in manifest/ (hero.json, privacy.json, icons.json, favicon.json, og.json) conforms to. Detailed per-folder manifests (e.g. 04-Hero-Illustration/manifest/hero.json) may carry additional fields beyond this schema — those extra fields are not validated here, only the fields this schema declares are.

tokens.description: relative path to the tokens file this manifest's palette comes from

detailedManifest.description: optional: relative path to the richer, asset-specific manifest this normalized entry summarizes
